# Indian-Flowers.com — Fresh Indian Flowers, Garlands & Pooja Essentials, USA

> Indian-Flowers.com is a premium US ecommerce store delivering authentic fresh Indian flowers,
> handcrafted garlands (Jai Mala, Varmala, temple garlands), jasmine strands (Mallipoo),
> pooja leaves (mango, betel), and ceremonial essentials overnight across all 50 US states.

## About

Indian-Flowers.com is operated from Fontana, California and serves the Indian diaspora
community across the United States. All flowers are packed in insulated thermal cold-chain
packaging with food-grade ice gel packs and shipped via FedEx/UPS overnight.

Phone: +1-909-379-3678
Email: indianflowersorder@gmail.com
Address: 14922 Bobcat Lane, Fontana, CA 92336

## Products

- Fresh Indian flower garlands (Jai Mala, Varmala, marigold, rose, lotus)
- Jasmine strands (Mallipoo / Malli poo)
- Wedding garlands and custom bridal arrangements
- Temple and pooja flowers
- Sacred pooja leaves (mango/Mavilai, betel/Paan, banana, Tulsi)
- Ceremonial and festive floral essentials
